mapper.select: SELECT id, document_id, creator_user_id, token_hash, permission, expires_at, max_uses, used_count, enabled, revoked_at, create_time, update_time FROM biz_document_share_link WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}

SELECT id, document_id, creator_user_id, token_hash, permission, expires_at, max_uses, used_count, enabled, revoked_at, create_time, update_time FROM biz_document_share_link WHERE document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, document_id, creator_user_id, token_hash, permission, expires_at, max_uses, used_count, enabled, revoked_at, create_time, update_time FROM biz_document_share_link WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_document_share_link (document_id, creator_user_id, token_hash, permission, expires_at, max_uses, used_count, enabled, revoked_at) VALUES (#{shareLink.documentId}, #{shareLink.creatorUserId}, #{shareLink.tokenHash}, #{shareLink.permission}, #{shareLink.expiresAt}, #{shareLink.maxUses}, COALESCE(#{shareLink.usedCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{shareLink.enabled}, 1), #{shareLink.revokedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_document_share_link SET used_count = used_count + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = 1 AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND used_count < max_uses
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_document_share_link_redemption (share_link_id, user_id, permission, redeemed_at) VALUES (#{redemption.shareLinkId}, #{redemption.userId}, #{redemption.permission}, COALESCE(#{redemption.redeemedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE permission = VALUES(permission)
